reason: My cousin in India already handles this kind of thing for me and doesn't charge a rupee. Paying $199 to a company I've never heard of, when I have a person I trust, doesn't make sense to me.
objection: Why pay anyone when my relative sorts it out for free? And I don't know this company, so I'd be handing a stranger my NRO details and ₹10 lakh.
would_change_my_mind: If my relative could no longer do it, or if the tax paperwork (Form 145/146) became too complex or risky for him to handle, and I could verify the company through someone I know who has used it.
